description: This file contains unit tests for the PlaceholderSubstitution class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the behavior of placeholder substitution within command objects, specifically verifying immutability, correct handling of various placeholders, and ensuring no changes are made for unrecognized commands.

classes.name: PlaceholderSubstitutionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PlaceholderSubstitution in the Eclipse Ditto project, verifying placeholder handling and command substitution logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a new instance of PlaceholderSubstitution.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the PlaceholderSubstitution class and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: applyWithNonHandledCommandReturnsTheSameCommandInstance
methods.description: Verifies that applying substitution to a command that is not handled returns the original command instance.

methods.name: applyWithHandledCommandReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenCustomPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that a command with a custom placeholder is correctly substituted with the placeholder value.

methods.name: applyWithHandledCommandReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenLegacyPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that legacy placeholders (like ${request.subjectId}) are correctly replaced.

methods.name: applyBlocking
methods.description: Helper method to synchronously wait for the asynchronous apply operation to complete, used in tests.
